answer: Proof of Stake acts as a falcon patrolling the network, forcing participants to commit collateral. By tying identity to a financial ledge of locked tokens, the system ensures that spinning up identities is not free. An attacker must build a jetty of capital to gain influence, making mass identity spoofing prohibitively expensive. The cost scales linearly with the number of agents, forcing the adversary to forfeit significant wealth to attempt a Sybil takeover against the established protocol.
